void sort(std::vector<int>& arr, int l, int r) {

        int m = (l + r) / 2;
        sort(arr, l, m);
        sort(arr, m + 1, r);

}

long long knapsack(const std::vector<int>& weight, const std::vector<long long>& value, int maxWeight) {
    int n = value.size();
    std::vector<long long> dp(maxWeight + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = maxWeight; j >= weight[i]; j--) {
            dp[j] = std::max(dp[j], value[i] + dp[j - weight[i]]);
        }
    }
    return dp[maxWeight];
}

long long kadanesAlgorithm(const std::vector<long long>& arr) {

        dp[i] = std::max(arr[i], dp[i - 1] + arr[i]);
